## Orientation

Territory: orchestra/stage/hooks.py only (orchestra/views.py if a helper is genuinely needed). Wave 1 (compact-hook-view) is merged: `views.hook_handoff_sections(records)` returns `(effort, text)` per live effort, newest position first, without id links, and `views.hook_constraints` covers every live effort. `cmd_start` currently joins those sections under `# Project Handoff`, still passes them through `_truncate`, and appends constraint lines after the handoff. Keep the `# Project Handoff` title line: two existing tests assert it. No other task runs concurrently in this phase.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/hook-context-budget--hook-budget`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R1: For a store whose full handoff exceeds 10,000 characters, the start hook context is at most 9,000 characters.
R2: The start hook context begins with the protocol text.
R3: The constraints block comes before the first effort section.
R8: When the efforts do not fit the budget, the hook omits whole effort sections and never emits part of one.
R9: Each omitted effort is named by slug on one line that points to `orchestra handoff --effort <slug>`.
R12: The plain (Cursor) hook format applies the same budget and content as the Claude format.

## Approach

In orchestra/stage/hooks.py replace MAX_HANDOFF_BYTES and _truncate with HOOK_CONTEXT_BUDGET = 9000. cmd_start builds protocol, constraint lines, then appends each section from views.hook_handoff_sections while the running length stays within budget; collect the rest and add one "Not shown: a, b. Run `orchestra handoff --effort <slug>`." line before the footer. Raise MAX_HOOK_CONSTRAINTS to 20. Replace test_hook_start_truncates_oversized_handoff.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R1: For a store whose full handoff exceeds 10,000 characters, the start hook context is at most 9,000 characters.
R2: The start hook context begins with the protocol text.
R3: The constraints block comes before the first effort section.
R8: When the efforts do not fit the budget, the hook omits whole effort sections and never emits part of one.
R9: Each omitted effort is named by slug on one line that points to `orchestra handoff --effort <slug>`.
R12: The plain (Cursor) hook format applies the same budget and content as the Claude format.

### Design / decisions (quote)

Invariants: The start hook context never exceeds HOOK_CONTEXT_BUDGET plus the omitted-efforts line and footer. `orchestra handoff` output is byte-identical to before.

Assumptions: Each effort has at most one active effort-scoped position; an effort with none sorts last.

hook-context-shape: Hook renders a compact view: needed roles only, no id links, constraints first, 9,000-character budget that omits whole efforts oldest-position first and names them

### Frozen oracle (do not edit)

tests/test_hooks.py (sha256 656488cb920555cd6e6fb70ac1ff9c881df9c739427c69b6e4467205f2284b91) is frozen. Do not edit it. The Approach's "Replace test_hook_start_truncates_oversized_handoff" is already done in the frozen file. An oracle hash or test-id change is a signed amendment in `.tuner/manifest.json`. orchestra verify verdict accepts or rejects it. A non-zero exit means the acceptance is not done.
